steps.title: Sizing policy and renderer parity
scope: Implement the strict pure render policy and its unit tests exactly as §3 and §9 Step 1 specify.
Implement the shared per-renderer size synchronizer and wire the main renderer with mount-box measurement, DPR re-arming, frame-start sync, and ordered cleanup.
Apply the same sizing contract to warp, remove window-sized rendering, and close the existing warp catch-path cleanup gap.
Verify AC-1 through AC-4, AC-7 through AC-9, and the scoped AC-17 cleanup assertion without beginning context recovery.

steps.title: Context lifecycle, recovery, and browser coverage
scope: Implement the pure context lifecycle, rebuild-by-remount controller, durable snapshot seeding, transient reset, listener/loop discipline, and the full outgoing-context teardown order.

Implement the recovery panel, terminal runtime notice, CockpitEntry lost state, ResponsiveStage integration, focus/live-region/accessibility behavior, and warp loss completion using the exact approved copy.
Add development-only renderer test hooks and the Phase 3 browser suite for AC-5, AC-11 through AC-21 while preserving every documented bridge and the Phase 6 test.fixme.
Record any D4 or R2 fallback from implementation evidence; do not begin DPR baselines or documentation completion.

steps.title: DPR tooling and owner evidence checkpoint
scope: Implement scripts/perf/dpr-baseline.ts and the Phase 3 DPR evidence structure.
Run and record only the software-rendered capture with its unmasked renderer string, and prepare the owner hardware capture and about:gpucrash procedure.
Do not self-certify hardware or about:gpucrash evidence, do not decide from SwiftShader numbers, and do not begin final documentation.
After fresh Kimi QA, stop for the explicit AC-23 owner checkpoint; leave Step 7 changes uncommitted for the final baselines-and-docs commit group.

steps.title: Contracts, documentation, and full acceptance evidence
scope: Require and verify the owner-certified hardware capture and one-time about:gpucrash recovery evidence from the accepted Step 7 checkpoint; never self-certify either item.
Complete only the Phase 3 contract and documentation amendments in §6 and §9 Step 8, including the approved DESIGN.md bullet when applicable.
Do not include the separate Phase 2 housekeeping corrections without their own owner approval.
Run all five gates and complete AC-6, AC-22 through AC-24 evidence, visual review, untouched-boundary proof, fallback reporting, and the Phase 3 implementation report.

commitAfterQa.message: Phase 3: record DPR evidence and delivery
